mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a temperature of 40 degrees.

The City of Verona has announced that asphalt repair work will take place on November 10 and 11, affecting areas like Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, where no parking will be enforced from 7 AM to 7 PM.
There is plenty to do in our community, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow and trivia events next week.

In a noteworthy call, the Verona Police Department arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I on October 25 after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor of the day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough; the restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 11:00 PM tonight.
